scripted_findings.title: No price found in the raw HTML of 2 page(s) that should carry one
scripted_findings.evidence: 2 page(s) whose URL/role commits them to state a price contain no price-shaped token anywhere in the raw response - not in visible text, JSON-LD, meta tags, or any hydration payload. Examples: ['https://www.logitech.com/en-in/products/combos/pop-icon-combo (role=product)', 'https://www.logitech.com/en-in/products/tablet-keyboards/keys-to-go2-universal (role=product)']. scripted_findings.title: Brand identity is not anchored to any external profile
scripted_findings.evidence: None of the 12 crawled page(s) declares Organization, LocalBusiness or similar structured data with sameAs links. Without sameAs, an assistant has nothing distinguishing this brand from others sharing the name, which is the standard cause of mistaken identity.

scripted_findings.title: No Product structured data on 1 product page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: 1/12 crawled product pages carry no Product JSON-LD, so the price, availability and identity of the item are stated only in prose, if at all. Examples: ['https://www.logitech.com/fr-fr/shop/c/keyboards']. Structured data is read by the indexing crawlers that build the search index assistants query.
